go-jsonschema generate --schema schema.json --out ./model --package model --type Schema

exec go test -count=1 ./model

-- schema.json --
{
  "type": ["object", "boolean"],
  "properties": {
    "id":    {"type": "string"},
    "title": {"type": "string"}
  },
  "required": ["id"]
}
-- go.mod --
module example.com/typedobj

go 1.26
-- model/model_test.go --
package model

import (
	"encoding/json/v2"
	"testing"
)

// The object variant of Schema should be a typed struct with the
// declared properties, not map[string]any.
func TestSchema_ObjectVariantIsTypedStruct(t *testing.T) {
	var s Schema
	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(`{"id":"abc","title":"hi"}`), &s); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("Unmarshal: %v", err)
	}
	got, ok := s.TypeObject()
	if !ok {
		t.Fatalf("TypeObject ok=false, want true")
	}
	if got.Id != "abc" {
		t.Errorf("Id = %q, want abc", got.Id)
	}
	if got.Title == nil || *got.Title != "hi" {
		t.Errorf("Title = %v, want pointer to 'hi'", got.Title)
	}
}

func TestSchema_BooleanVariant(t *testing.T) {
	var s Schema
	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(`true`), &s); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("Unmarshal: %v", err)
	}
	if got, ok := s.TypeBoolean(); !ok || got != true {
		t.Errorf("TypeBoolean = (%v, %v), want (true, true)", got, ok)
	}
}

func TestSchema_RequiredEnforced(t *testing.T) {
	var s Schema
	err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(`{"title":"missing id"}`), &s)
	if err == nil {
		t.Fatalf("Unmarshal: err = nil, want missing-required-field")
	}
}

func TestSchema_RoundTripObject(t *testing.T) {
	in := []byte(`{"id":"x","title":"y"}`)
	var s Schema
	if err := json.Unmarshal(in, &s); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("Unmarshal: %v", err)
	}
	out, err := json.Marshal(s)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("Marshal: %v", err)
	}
	if string(out) != string(in) {
		t.Errorf("Marshal = %s, want %s", out, in)
	}
}
